Compounded sales growth over 10, 5, and 3 years sits at -30%, -19%, and -46% respectively, demonstrating a long-term contraction of the core business [E13, E14, E15]. Profitability metrics are deeply negative, highlighted by a trailing twelve-month operating margin of -85% and a 10-year median return on equity of -5% [E23, E27]. Furthermore, the company destroys capital through operations, posting negative operating and free cash flows of -0.60 Cr in March 2026 alongside a weak cash conversion of 0.61x [E31, E32, E33]. Valuation disconnected entirely from fundamental reality, pricing the stock at 4.11x book value despite chronic value destruction and a low return on equity [E1, E56, E62]. This massive divergence is explicitly flagged by the data showing that recent price growth exceeds profit growth by 371%, proving that expectations are running dangerously ahead of actual delivery [E50].
